prose.text: "Which connectors serve this application, and why does traffic fail?" needs the server group questions answered in order.

steps.label: What is a server group, and what selects it?
steps.text: The segment names it, and a policy rule can override it: [[zpa.server-groups.role]].

steps.label: Does it hold servers or discover them?
steps.text: Dynamic Server Discovery against explicit servers, and the defaults that differ between sources: [[zpa.server-groups.discovery-mode]].

steps.label: Which App Connector groups does it bind?
steps.text: The connector list, how a connector is picked, and what is not known about an empty list: [[zpa.server-groups.connector-binding]].

steps.label: Is there more than one server group on the segment?
steps.text: Weights, passive flags and the Multimatch rules: [[zpa.server-groups.multiple-on-segment]].

steps.label: Is the chain from segment to connected connector intact?

prose.text: The Python SDK's update body is in [[zpa.server-groups.update-payload]]. The Terraform delete cleanup is in [[zpa.server-groups.delete]] and, for failure handling shared with other objects, in [[zpa.terraform.delete-paths]].

Policy rules that scope on segment groups, rather than on server groups, are covered in [[zpa.segment-groups.policy-use]] and [[zpa.policy.criteria]]. The segments that carry server groups are in [[zpa.app-segments]]. The App Connector side is in [[zpa.app-connectors.connector-groups]].
